audience_tailoring.description: Adapt the tone and detail based on who will be reading this summary (individual hobbyist, corporate, government, etc.).
audience_tailoring.title: Audience Tailoring

focus_and_context.description: A short statement about why this project or plan exists and its overall objectives.
focus_and_context.title: Focus And Context

purpose_and_goals.description: A crisp statement of the project's main goals and success criteria.
purpose_and_goals.title: Purpose And Goals

key_deliverables_and_outcomes.description: Bulleted summary of the expected end-products or results from the plan.
key_deliverables_and_outcomes.title: Key Deliverables And Outcomes

timeline_and_budget.description: A short estimate of time and top-level budget
timeline_and_budget.title: Timeline And Budget

risks_and_mitigations.description: Identify 1-2 major risks and how you plan to reduce or address them.
risks_and_mitigations.title: Risks And Mitigations

action_orientation.description: Explain the immediate actions or next steps needed to move forward. Summarize who, what, and when.
action_orientation.title: Action Orientation

overall_takeaway.description: A final, concise statement emphasizing the main point or value of the plan (e.g., expected benefits or key success metric).
overall_takeaway.title: Overall Takeaway

feedback.description: Suggestions for how to strengthen the executive summary by adding more evidence or improving persuasiveness.
feedback.title: Feedback
